maddeler.e:
اغتلتن (form VIII)
# اِغْتَلْتُنَّ (iḡtaltunna) /iɣ.tal.tun.na/: second-person feminine plural past active of اِغْتَالَ (iḡtāla)
# اُغْتِلْتُنَّ (uḡtiltunna) /uɣ.til.tun.na/: second-person feminine plural past passive of اِغْتَالَ (iḡtāla)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
